findings.evidence: Removing the custom HOSTNAME=0.0.0.0 app setting caused /api/health, /, /why-we-exist, /contact, and /api/intake GET to begin responding from the staging default host.
OneDeploy attempt 9cfafb99-d74c-4112-9a83-4e85bc3d5722 ran Oryx even though SCM_DO_BUILD_DURING_DEPLOYMENT=false and ENABLE_ORYX_BUILD=false were set.
findings.result: OneDeploy path rejected for current remediation

findings.evidence: A temporary Kudu deployment record temp-423edf3a remained active with status 0 across repeated polls after an interrupted config-zip deployment.

Downloaded container logs showed repeated `Error: Cannot find module '/home/site/wwwroot/server.js'` on worker lw1sdlwk001165 while the corrected artifact had previously served routes from another worker after HOSTNAME removal.
Downloaded Kudu logs showed OneDeploy invoked Oryx and failed with `ERROR: Could not find cached tarball for nodejs 24.18.0`.
Log streaming and interactive SSH were unreliable while the slot was unhealthy. Log download eventually succeeded and provided deployment/container evidence.
